## Change and findings

Describe the question or correction, affected study/version and expected benefit. For a small documentation correction, a short explanation is enough.

## Sources, assets and permissions

Identify sources, attribution, changed asset identities and the confirmed rights to share and incorporate them. Implementation patches require the confirmed incoming-rights route in CONTRIBUTING.md. Link permitted evidence; never attach restricted material to this public PR. Arrange private intake with an owner first.

## Reproduction and checks

For experiments, give the environment, steps, comparison/selection rule, results (including negative findings), resource boundaries and shareable evidence. For documentation, describe link/content checks. State limitations and material AI assistance. A passing CI job is not scientific validation.

## Owner review record

Owner completes before merge: reviewed diff/assets, rights and disclosure outcome, evidence assessment, and any substantive review exception. Record whether this merge qualifies for Lab eligibility and why; leave undecided until assessed. Two qualifying merges still require a separate private owner access review. Do not put applicant/private access or Strategic-consent records in this public PR. Qualifying merges support an owner access review for the relevant research cycle; they do not automatically confer access to the next cycle or to Strategic development. Direct contact/private-intake requests go to Anthony Siljeg at asiljeg@alnotrea.com, initially without restricted attachments.
